author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented a server-side ResourceGuard that monitors free disk on the configured storage mount and daemon RSS, reports pressure through SystemHealthMonitor, emits ResourcePressureEvent warnings on the resource_pressure tracing target, and requests RunEngine pause when thresholds are crossed while running. author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented calibration staleness gating end-to-end. Radiance calibrator files now parse RFC3339 calibration_timestamp/device_type headers, RunEngine tracks active calibration freshness with a default 24h spectroscopy threshold and blocks stale starts, ScriptPlanRunner propagates script-loaded radiance calibration freshness into the shared RunEngine, and Experiment Designer highlights CalibrationStalenessGate warnings. Also fixed hardware registry capability propagation so gated_camera/spectrometer_control survive registration and appear in DeviceInfo. Verified with cargo test -p common --lib; cargo test -p experiment --lib; cargo test -p scripting --features libs_scripting --lib libs_bindings::tests::test_calibrator_rhai_api_unity; cargo check -p server --features scripting; cargo check -p ui --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features web; git diff --check. Full cargo test -p scripting --features libs_scripting --lib still has the pre-existing unrelated failure in shutter_safety::tests::test_emergency_close_all_shutters_from_registry.

author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented SpectrumPayload on the existing StreamSpectra RPC instead of rewriting StreamMeasurements into a oneof transport, because the live codebase already split scalar and spectrum streaming. Added a rich protocol message with ivar/order/merge/profile/quality/SNR fields, preserved name/timestamp/intensity_unit/metadata_json for transport context, updated server/client mappings, and added server tests for metadata-derived payload fields.

author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented server-side echelle extraction by promoting the shared extraction kernel into common::echelle and wiring an opt-in latest-wins stage off the existing frame-to-measurement pipeline. Devices with driver config key echelle_profile_path now load a profile at startup, raw image measurements still flow unchanged, extracted spectra are emitted on the same measurement bus with device_id metadata/top-level payload field, and StreamSpectra now filters by either spectrum name or device_id. Validation: cargo test -p common test_extract_preview_emits_device_scoped_measurements; cargo test -p server test_stream_spectra_filters_by_device_id_metadata; cargo check -p server -p client; cargo check -p ui --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features web.

author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented UI-to-RunEngine echelle snapshot propagation. RunEngine calibration snapshots now merge radiance and echelle fields instead of replacing the whole spectroscopy entry, with targeted clear methods for radiance vs echelle state. Added a new RunEngineService calibration snapshot RPC surface, client wrappers, and ImageViewerPanel background sync so the active EchelleCalibrationProfile compatibility block is pushed to the daemon (scoped to the selected camera device) and cleared independently without clobbering script-managed radiance coverage. Validation: cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p experiment --lib; cargo check -p server; cargo check -p client; cargo check -p scripting --features libs_scripting; cargo check -p ui --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features web; git diff --check.

author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented crash-recovery cleanup for stale SDK runtime artifacts. PVCAM init now detects already-initialized/device-in-use style errors, removes vendor-prefixed artifacts under /tmp and /dev/shm, and retries pl_pvcam_init() once. Andor camera init now retries once on AT_ERR_DEVICEINUSE after the same targeted cleanup; Shamrock retry is limited to ShamrockInitialize communication failures. Added cleanup/classifier unit tests and expanded Andor error strings for code 38 and Shamrock init codes. Validation: cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p driver-pvcam --lib; cargo test -p driver-andor-sdk3 --lib; cargo test -p common radiance_calibration; cargo check -p driver-andor-sdk3 --features camera,spectrograph; git diff --check. Limitations: cargo check -p driver-pvcam --features pvcam_sdk is blocked locally because PVCAM_SDK_DIR is not set; cargo clippy -p driver-andor-sdk3 --all-targets --features camera,spectrograph -- -D warnings still fails on a large pre-existing crate-wide lint backlog unrelated to bd-03mp.

author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented frame-gap integrity propagation end-to-end. Preserved frame_number/binning/temperature/ROI metadata when converting frames to Measurement::Image, annotate ring-buffer image gaps as sequence_gap_from_previous, emit DataIntegrityFault warnings on ring-buffer writers, surface those warnings into the native UI status bar, and teach HDF5 flushes to decode measurement-bincode snapshots with data_integrity_fault_count/data_integrity_faults_json metadata while preserving legacy ScanProgress fallback. author: TheFermiSea
text: Current state after inspection: render_echelle_calibration_wavelength_fit_tab already supports manual per-order least-squares fitting from existing calibration points plus a residual scatter plot and RMS summary. The missing work against US-011 is the assisted flow: (1) detect-arc-lines action + overlay markers and line metrics, (2) atlas matching workflow and include/exclude line table, (3) ±1σ/±3σ residual bands + used/total badges, and (4) export fitted wavelength solution back into the active profile. The implementation surface remains concentrated in crates/ui/src/panels/image_viewer/mod.rs, with helper hooks likely needed for US-009/US-010 integration.

author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented the streamed spectrum UI on top of the existing LiveVisualizationPanel instead of adding a second plotting stack. LiveVisualization now caches spectra per device keyed by merged/order, renders a 10-snapshot running average, shows merged/order selectors, draws ±1σ ivar shading, and displays SNR + quality flags. ExperimentDesigner now provisions spectrum panels for camera acquire nodes and spawns StreamSpectra subscriptions filtered by camera device ID, feeding SpectrumPayload metadata into the spectrum channel. Validation: cargo fmt --all; cargo check -p ui --lib; cargo check -p ui --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features web; cargo test -p ui --lib; cargo clippy -p ui --lib -- -D warnings; cargo clippy -p ui --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features web -- -D warnings.

author: TheFermiSea
text: Implemented pre-run calibration config matching in RunEngine. Added spectroscopy grating/wavelength coverage checks, optional echelle frame-compatibility checks, device_id reporting on readiness issues, and a new DeviceRegistry spectrometer-control accessor. RadianceCalibrator now exposes loaded gratings + wavelength bounds, and LIBS scripting always registers coverage metadata even when calibration_timestamp is missing so config-match gating still works for legacy calibration files. Validation: cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p common radiance_calibration; cargo test -p experiment --lib; cargo test -p scripting --features libs_scripting test_create_radiance_calibrator_registers_coverage_without_timestamp; cargo check -p scripting --features libs_scripting; git diff --check.
